name: Oda Nobunaga
role: Daimyo of Owari, then unifier of central Japan
note: Brusque, impatient with priests and protocol; pays well for useful strangeness.

name: Toyotomi Hideyoshi
role: Nobunaga's general, later ruler of Japan
note: Effusive, canny; loves omens that flatter his rise.

name: Tokugawa Ieyasu
note: Reserved, watchful; tests visitors with long silences.

name: Akechi Mitsuhide
note: Poet-warrior; slights fester. Dangerous to flatter wrongly after June 1582.

name: Sen no Rikyu
role: Tea master, arbiter of taste and politics
note: Wabi minimalism; every gesture weighed. A tea room is a courtroom.

name: Takeno Joo disciple-merchant
note: Counts coins and curses with equal care; pays coin, never gossip, for discretion.

name: Jesuit padre (Organtino)
role: Christian missionary in the capital region
note: Curious about onmyodo as natural philosophy; offers books, seeks converts.

name: Tsuchimikado elder
note: Polite gatekeeper of the art; freelance onmyoji are tolerated, watched, taxed in favors.
